create_block_object: create a BlockObjectNode from a sequence of Minecraft blocks in agent memory
create_mob_node: create a MobNode in memory to track a Minecraft mob entity with position and look
create_schematic_node: create a SchematicNode from a sequence of blocks representing a build plan
create_inst_seg_node: create an InstSegNode to represent an ephemeral region of space with voxel locations
create_reward_node: create a RewardNode in memory to record a reward value with a timestamp
